newsitem.title: USA: Cox launches cable Internet access service.
newsitem.headline: Cox launches cable Internet access service.

text.p: Cox Communications Inc said it has launched its CoxHome Network, a high-speed Internet service, to customers in the Mission Viejo area of Orange County, Calif.

The new service, offered in conjunction with Home Network, a provider of high-speed interactive services, connects personal computers to the Internet with high-speed cable modems and its proprietary network.

Cox said its broadband network sends data at up to hundreds of times faster than a typical analog telephone modem, making for almost instant access to the Internet and allowing customers to use video and graphically intense material.
The company said it would market the service in Fremont, Calif., Baltimore, Md., and Orange County, Calif., along with its cable partners: Tele-Communications Inc and Comcast Corp.
